'''Don''', known as the '''Exiled Knight''', was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who lived in [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]]<ref name="DonEpic1" /> in a makeshift camp with a bonfire in the canyons of [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] during the [[Invasion of Ossus]].<ref name="DonDawn" />

==Biography==
In times of [[Battle of Ilum|war]] on the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-[[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] Don committed an action he had to explain himself for in front of the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]]. According to his own words, the Jedi Council remained unswayed.<ref name="DonEpic1" />

Subsequently, Don was either exiled because of his actions on Ilum or he chose exile voluntarily, consequently having roamed the harsh galaxy alone.<ref name="DonEpic1" /> He eventually found sympathetic minds in the [[Order of Revan]] on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Don considered a paradise by any standard.<ref name="DonEpic4" />
After the [[Battle of Rishi]] and the downfall off the [[Order of Revan]], Don found himself stranded with his only path forward being among [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi's]] scofflaw denizens. The Exiled Knight then joined the [[Corellian Run Scoundrels]].<ref name="DonEpic4" />

At some point in history, Don spent his time frozen in carbonite and was released years later.<ref name="DonEpic12">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=codex|The Epic of the Exiled Knight: Part Twelve}}</ref>
He realized that he was left adrift in a galaxy he no longer understood and felt as if there was no place he would belong to. Don picked up on rumors that the Jedi were in hiding and contemplated whether to return to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and rebuild among them.<ref name="DonEpic12" />

Having believed his actions were long forgotten, Don found the hidden ruins of an ancient order but was rejected once more. Don eventually continued to wander around aimlessly and settled down in the canyons of [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]].<ref name="DonEpic17">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=codex|The Epic of the Exiled Knight: Part Seventeen}}</ref>

Don the Exiled Knight wrote down his story and thoughts in seventeen or more journals. The first,<ref name="DonEpic1" /> fourth,<ref name="DonEpic4" /> twelfth<ref name="DonEpic12" /> and seventeenth<ref name="DonEpic17" /> book were scattered and found at different locations on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]].

===Reputation in the galaxy===
During his ventures across the galaxy, Don became a myth-enshrouded [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] sensation and achieved a literary fanbase throughout the galaxy seemingly overnight. This kickstarted an unprecedented search by [[Journalist/Legends|journalists and investigators]] who hoped to find and learn the truth about his story from Don first-hand.<ref name="DonDawn" />

==Personality and traits==
Don was a corpulent [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] attired in [[Color/Legends|dark brown]] and light brown robes. His head featured the prominent horns of the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Don was equipped with a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] projecting a [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|red]] beam.<ref name="DonDawn" />

==Behind the scenes==
Don the Exiled Knight appeared in the [[2018]] patch 5.10 "Jedi Under Siege" on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]].
He is featured in a secondary quest in which the player needs to discover his four journals in order to locate and eliminate the exiled Jedi. Upon being accomplished, the player receives Don the Exiled Knight as a Stronghold-decoration.<ref name="DonDawn" />
